This bean plot is small, only a fraction of my land, and beans don't need much fertilizer because they feed themselves from the soil. I have some education and I know fertilizer costs money, so I save it for my teff and wheat plots where it matters more. I will use seed I saved from last season, and add a little manure from the household animals to keep the soil strong. My family will do the work — weeding and harvest — there is no need to hire anyone for such a small plot.
